Cause: failed_last() kept a shop out of choose() for FAIL_MEMORY 6 h after ONE out-of-stock turn-away, for every item, and with no visit the lock never cleared. inextro turned us away at 04:30 (none of that sofa in stock) and 07:47; 32 shops were locked at once (kimauve, dragonash, lee-sungsoo, sergiobuilds, ...). So the rival_penalty 0.04->0.02 and inextro bias 0.06->0.03 moves of 11:01 were answers to the wrong cause: re-read them after 2 h of the fix and revert if inextro's share comes back on its own. Watch per-deal saved and deals/h for the next 2 h.

(2) goods price: peers' goods run .35-.43 (dae-yangkim .426, nocha12 .387, seochanit .383) vs our .329; at .38 we would also get ~.396. Food at .413 is already above the market (.365).
